cached_live.evidence: Saved live paper search; API writes blocked. No new provider/model/document retrieval.

privacy.scope: Exact configured env key/token/contact values in git-visible tracked and untracked working files. Excludes ignored env/state/dependencies; not Git history, encoded values, unknown secrets or OCR.

notes: 53 affected cases are covered; initial52passed and one cancellation test expected a browser network-failure event for an intercepted fetch. The corrected test observes the real AbortSignal and verifies no late file save; final6PDF cases pass. No runtime change was needed for that test correction.
Durations cover saved view, original search timestamps, metadata/details/DOI, abstract requests and media/PDF operations. A frame load does not prove all pages rendered or video buffering finished.
The inline download saves actual PDF bytes on explicit action, validates the PDF signature, caps transfer at50MB and30seconds, and supports cancellation. It does not parse or index full text.
Publisher/browser CORS or login restrictions can block direct download. The explicit new-tab/native-viewer fallback remains available; no automatic retry or server relay was added.
Saved-live checks at6 widths blocked API writes and preserved provider/model usage. No new live research, document fetch, model request, restart, commit or push was performed.
